item.title: Suggestins for Additions
item.content:encoded:
The page is locked from editing right now, and even if I could edit it I'm not really sure how to incorporate these. These are 4 tales which I feel deeply involve the O5s, and show different aspects of their work and role in the foundation, which currently are not included or mentioned, and which I'm suggesting for inclusion in the page.

The first is the Conspiracy, a series of tales about intelligence/espionage/intrigue behind the Veil. It doesn't seemed to have achieved large scale popularity/fame, but it involves several O5's, primarily O5-7 for major plot points, it's been around for a long time, and I personally love reading it. Score: 32 at this time, for the Hub.

+ Possible spoilers involving the end
- Not sure if spoiler worth, but better safe than sorry

If writing an entry for O5-7 at the end of the tale, I was thinking about "The Investigator" as his title, but wasn't sure what do write beyond that, or what to write or add for his precursor.

The second is SCP-2508. It doesn't heavily feature the O5s, but again, O5-7 makes an appearance, being affected by the anomaly. We don't get much information on this one, so maybe use it as the explanation for the disappearance of one of the other O5-7 personas, preferably one young enough to live 23+ years inside the anomaly, after their disappearance? Score: 368 at this time.

The third is SCP-2718, which, also again, heavily involves O5-7 (what's up with O5-7 and stuff happening to them?) O5-11 is also important to the plot, as well as the rest of the O5 council, although 7 and 11 get the most characterization and developement, and I feel like personas/identities for these two could be written based off of their 2718 appearances. Score: 814 at this time.

The last is Empty Unmarked Grave from the The Cool War, which deals with the Administrator and possible other cover stories/ false identities for him. Score: 160 at this time.

Again, I'd like to add these, and feel they are important enough to warrant consideration, but am restricted by my lack of writing abilities and the locking of the page. If someone could give a shot at these, I believe the page would benefit from their inclusion.

As Decibelle alluded to, the last thing I want here is to codify anything. That's why the page specifies that the reports usually mutually contradict each other, and O5 Command might not even exist.

I changed the bolded line on the opening page to:

This dossier will show you contradictory reports on each of the O5 Council members.

Hopefully that makes it a little clearer that the many reports in each tab are not supposed to be canon to each other unless otherwise stated (and none are supposed to be the final word on anything, period).

Any suggestions to make that even clearer are welcome!

I felt the little blurb about the O5 Command and the Administrator in the Personnel and Character Dossier was perfect.

Well, thank you, I wrote those too! But technically that's far more codified than this page is… just less specific.

The primary goal of this page is to be a hub for many entertaining versions of O5 Command, without ever canonizing any single interpretation. Not even the interpretation given on the Character Dossier.

I dislike this. I can understand why people do like it, but I don't.

To me, understanding what the O5 command is and realizing your own interpretation is a big part of growing as a community member and eventually writer. There have been a ton of different interpretation of the characters, to the point where I would argue that members of O5 command are the most fluid characters on the site.

I feel this page codifies something that is best left intentionally vague. I felt the little blurb about the O5 Command and the Administrator in the Personnel and Character Dossier was perfect. It left the characters and even their existence up to personal headcanon, and I think that's important.

item.content:encoded:
How This Page Works:

  1. Anyone with a relatively popular story can add their O5/O5s/Admin here.
  2. Staff may edit, tweak, or remove the entry, but will not remove any entry that is in an established, popular work unless they have special reason (which must be posted on this comment page so that other staff, and the community, will judge it).
    • Please link entries to articles in which the O5s appear. Err on the side of linking more, not less. (Wikiwalk, have a party!)
  3. Anyone can also add their own entry which is not established in any story. This works like the Log of Anomalous Items — poor or flawed entries will be reworked or entirely removed at staff discretion. No explanation for removal is required — so please make it good if you're adding something.
    • This page starts off with an exceptionally high number of 'seed' entries which don't exist on the site. Most entries should be established ones to counter-balance this — but if you have a really interesting idea, don't be shy.
    • Emphasis should be placed on 'usable' characters. If your headcanon/story version is too generic, too much like what anyone could've come up with, there's no need to add them here (we've covered most of the more generic entries already, I hope).
    • Goofy characters are allowed if they're good. However, they should be framed as false if they get too goofy (even if they aren't meant to be) to keep character consistency — aka, the author of the page may be particularly skeptical.
  4. Variations on specific established characters should be added to the main entry for that character and framed as "conflicting reports".
  5. Add new things to the bottom of the page, in order of creation. Staff may move or re-order for aesthetic purposes. (Especially popular entries should be near the top, so please feel free to request this.)
    • If this is judged unworkable, I recommend order of creation.
  6. The "Dissent" page is made for stuff that really skews away from standard O5 canon, such as 'they're all aliens' or 'they don't exist'. However, if you prefer to fit it into another tab, feel free.
  7. thedeadlymoose owns this page. Any staff member has blanket permission to alter it, including other users' entries. Again, similar to the Log of Anomalous Items.
  8. This page is an open collaboration and should remain so. This page should never be locked except in case of ongoing troll attack.

I first drafted this in January 2015. Now it's finally done. I cannot at this point remember who to credit with feedback, because so many people gave it.

TroyL outright created a great many of the entries on this list during a single massive brainstorming session where he unloaded ideas on me over a phone call and I wrote as fast as I could to keep up.

TheDuckman, Sophia Light, and DrEverettMann also had huge influences on this list, via a long history of work on O5 characters.

Decibelles, Roget, SoullessSingularity, Dexanote, djkaktus, Kestin, TwistedGears, TheDuckman, and TroyL (and many others I have certainly forgotten) gave a lot of very helpful feedback on this list. If I forgot to mention you, and you gave me feedback on this, remind me to add you. <3

Finally: All feedback welcome. Nothing here is set in stone. :)
